slides.title: Supply Chain Attacks Up 300% in 3 Years
slides.subtitle: and most companies have no one to stop them

bullets: Most orgs have zero dedicated supply chain security staff
SBOMs and vendor risk are now regulatory expectations
AppSec, GRC or DevSecOps backgrounds all qualify

caption: Supply chain security is one of the fastest-growing paths in cyber - and most companies are still scrambling to fill the gap. That gap is yours. #cybersecurity #supplychainsecurity #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs #infosec
